answer: Like a vault that opens for only one key each, admission can rest on a zero-knowledge proof of a unique government ID: the applicant proves the document sits in the official registry and its hidden commitment is not already registered, without revealing which document it is. A sybil farmer needs one genuine ID per fake identity, and each stolen ID leaves an echo in fraud reports that burns the whole batch. The limit: it leans on a trusted issuer registry, excludes people without documents, and the summit of its privacy rests on the soundness of the zero-knowledge proof.
